entries.subject: Cassini ISS frames, 2018 shape release and radial elevation
entries.finding: [PDS calibrated Cassini ISS](https://pds-rings.seti.org/cassini/iss/calibration.html) frames, the [2018 shape release and controlled camera table](https://sbnarchive.psi.edu/pds4/cassini/saturn_satellite_shape_models_V1_0/document/telesto_document.pdf) and shape-derived radial elevation supply the delivered views.

entries.subject: Cassini ISS frame N1831469816_1 in the Monochrome lens
entries.finding: It sees Telesto as a 147° phase crescent with every sample at 79–80° incidence; its median value is 0.151 against 0.54–0.74 in the other frames, and no overlap reaches it.
entries.revisitWhen: An overlapping frame can set its level, or photometry corrects values at that incidence.
